changelog:
0.2.0

  • Redirect module ported in from BT-Sched-5-Redirect — the /stores/ redirect portal and [bt_redirect_tab] now ship with the plugin. Deactivate the old snippet after updating.
  • Redirect tab: copy button on each URL Path row copies the full https link to the clipboard.
  • All option names, post meta keys, AJAX actions and the shortcode tag are unchanged, so existing redirect pages and click counts carry over untouched.

0.1.1

  • Stores tab: copy-to-clipboard icon beside each store's VIEW link.

0.1.0

  • Initial plugin release — full port of the BT-Sched WPCode snippets (DB + crons, REST API, [bt_schedule] frontend, head CSS).
  • Admin status page with update check, self-updater via GitHub manifest.
